A value that is entirely an interpolation is a reference TO a secret, never the
secret. The bare `${VAR}` form was already handled; every form below carries a
dot, a colon, a call or a space and used to slip through — the property-access
one is not exotic, it is what a minified JS bundle looks like.

let p = { apikey: `${this.supabaseKey}`, authorization: `${config.apiKey}` };
headers = {"api_key": "{settings.api_key}"}
password = "${env:DB_PASSWORD}"
password = "%(db_password)s"
secret: "{{vault_db_password}}"
secret: "{{ vault_db_password }}"
client_secret = "$(cat /run/secrets/client_secret)"
access_key = "#{ENV['AWS_ACCESS_KEY']}"
